credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/lotus.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: REARING: the seed pod rears on a C stalk from two plump lotus-root feet, its pitted pale face tilted at the foe; a cupped leaf raised as a shield, the last pink petal a cape. Intro: the shield leaf tips forward, a water bead rolls off its lip, falls and splashes, and the leaf springs back. Crystal rule: teal is the dark slot (leaves, stalk, seed holes, the shade on pink), lotus pink the light. Sport: Nelumbo nucifera 'Chawan Basu' (white tipped blush pink).
